blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Day 38 of the trial on Monday centered on the cross-examination of prosecution forensic financial analyst Alexander Cabrera, who conceded that his report showing P817 million in alleged unexplained wealth was based on available documents and did not include records submitted directly by Duterte or her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio. Defense counsel Kristine Ferrer also drew from Cabrera that Duterte declared only about 20 percent of her properties “on average,” a figure based on Cabrera’s own methodology. The Senate Impeachment Court ruled to retain on record the defense’s characterization of Cabrera’s testimony as erroneous, rejecting the prosecution’s bid […]...
